title: Screening Canine Feces with the MICROSEQ® Salmonella spp. Detection Kit
author: Sarah Nemser
materials: Preparation of Plates for KingFisher Duo or Flex
Use immediately or store at -20°C until use.
RapidFinder Express Software: RapidFinder ‱ Express Software | Thermo Fisher Scientific - US
Select a Run File Option specific to project
KingFisher Protocols can be found on ThermoFisher website: https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/AM1840
KingFisher equipment will give an estimated completion time for protocol once loaded
Protocol requires Pathogen High Volume program

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary solutions and bead mixes for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Add 12 mL 100% Isopropanol to the bottle labeled 'Wash Solution 1 Concentrate'.
Add 32 mL 100% Ethanol to the bottle labeled 'Wash Solution 2 Concentrate'.
Add 360 µL Carrier NA to the bottle labeled 'Lysis/Binding Solution Concentrate' and label as 'Lysis/Binding Solution'.
Add 1100 µL NA Binding Beads and 1100 µL Lysis/Binding Enhancer to a 15 ml tube; dispense 1000 μL into 1.5ml tubes and label as 'Bead Mix'.

steps.title: Sample Pre-enrichment
steps.instruction: Perform initial enrichment of the canine fecal samples.

substeps.instruction: Aseptically weigh 10 g of fecal sample into a Whirl-Pak bag using a tongue depressor.
Add 90 mL of ambient temperature buffered peptone water (BPW).
Mix the sample in the bag, ensuring the quantity of pre-enrichment medium yields a 1/10 dilution with feces.
Incubate at 37 °C ± 1 °C for 18 h ± 2 h.
Leave Whirl-Pak bags at room temperature until PCR results are available.

steps.title: Manual Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for extraction using the Bead Tube method.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 200 µL Lysis/Binding Solution into a Bead Tube for each unknown sample.
Add 300 µL of the pre-enriched fecal sample to each Bead Tube.
Vortex unknown samples using a Vortex adapter for 15 minutes at the highest setting (caps facing the center).
Centrifuge at 16,000 rcf for 3 min.

steps.title: Automated DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using the KingFisher instrument and MagMAX Pathogen Standard Volume protocol.

substeps.instruction: Label a Kingfisher 96 DW plate as 'Sample'; add 20 µL of Bead Mix to unknown sample wells.
Carefully add 300 µL of pre-enriched fecal sample supernatant to each well containing bead mix (do not disturb pellet in Bead Tube).
Add 150 µL of 100% Isopropanol to the unknown sample wells.
Label a Kingfisher 96 DW plate as 'Wash 1' and add 300 µL of Wash Solution 1 to corresponding wells.
Label a Kingfisher 96 DW plate as 'Wash 2' and add 450 µL of Wash Solution 2 to corresponding wells.
Label a 96 well plate as 'Elution' and add 75 µL of Elution Buffer to corresponding wells.
Place one 96 well DW tip comb onto a Kingfisher 96 200 ul plate, avoiding surface contamination.
Set up KingFisher Program according to the KingFisher Duo or Flex Protocol MagMAX Pathogen Standard Volume.
Load the instrument with the Wash, Sample, and Elution plates as directed.

steps.title: DNA Dilution
steps.instruction: Dilute the extracted DNA to a 1:10 ratio.

substeps.instruction: Label a 96 well plate as 'Dilution' and add 90 µL of Nuclease Free H2O to corresponding wells.
Transfer 10 µL of unknown sample from the Elution plate to the Dilution plate.
If inhibitors are suspected, perform subsequent serial dilutions.

steps.title: Alternative Manual Extraction/Dilution
steps.instruction: Perform manual extraction or dilution if the automated process is not used.

substeps.instruction: Remove 300 µL fecal sample to a 1.5 ml tube; centrifuge at highest speed for 3 min and discard supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 100 µL PrepMan Ultra Sample Preparation Reagent.
Incubate at 100°C for 10 min; centrifuge at highest speed for 3 minutes.
For a 1:10 dilution: Transfer 5 µL of the supernatant to a 1.5 mL tube and add 45 µL nuclease free water.
For a 1:100 dilution: Transfer 5 µL of the supernatant to a 1.5 mL tube and add 495 µL nuclease free water.

steps.title: PCR Reaction Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR reactions using the MicroSEQ Salmonella spp. Detection Kit.

substeps.instruction: Remove the required number of individual tubes or 8-tube strips.
Remove and discard colored caps without disturbing the beads at the bottom.
Add 25 µL of Nuclease free H2O to each tube.
Transfer 5 µL of the 1:10 diluted DNA to each tube for unknown samples or controls.
Seal tubes with transparent optical strip caps using the MicroAmp 96-Well Base and Cap Installing Tool.
Ensure strips are straight and tubes are aligned.

steps.title: PCR Amplification and Analysis
steps.instruction: Run the PCR on the ABI 7500-FAST machine and analyze results.

substeps.instruction: Configure the ABI 7500-FAST machine (fast mode) with: Holding Stage 1 (95°C, 20s), Cycling Stage 1 (40 cycles, 95°C, 3s), and Cycling Stage 2 (40 cycles, 60°C, 30s).
Enter the number of unknown samples and at least 1 negative and 1 positive control for each assay; confirm run layout.
Place samples in the thermocycler using the tube strip adapter, balancing the sides with blank tubes if necessary.
Analyze results using automatic analysis; all samples must have a VIC (internal control) signal.
If VIC is >35 or undetermined, repeat PCR using a 1:5 dilution of the sample in nuclease-free water.
Set the Threshold by selecting Positive Control wells, switching Graph Type to Linear, and placing the bar at the start of the exponential curve.
Save the original run file and export data to Excel for interpretation based on FAM and VIC signals.

steps.title: Sample Storage
steps.instruction: Store extracted DNA samples at -20°C for possible follow-up.
